verdict.what: an open-sided pavilion or pagoda-style hall with a stepped roof on a stone plinth
verdict.style: Asian-inspired pavilion, stepped pagoda roof, dark timber and grey stone
verdict.looks: A square, low pavilion on a two-tier base: a wide grey stone-brick plinth with a slight outward step, then a dark wood-plank platform with a waist-high dark balustrade. Inside the platform, a row of dark pillars and a recessed back wall with a few square window openings and hanging lanterns, all in very dark brown. Lantern posts with warm lights sit at the corners and along the front. The roof is a deep, wide eave with stair-stepped tiers rising to a narrow top, in the same dark brown planks as the walls. The front has a single stone-block step at the centre. Palette is almost monochrome dark brown plus grey stone, with warm lantern light as the only accent.
verdict.summary: A clear, well-proportioned pagoda pavilion with a strong stepped roof and a good stone plinth, but the all-dark-brown walls and roof merge into one mass and the stepped roof reads a bit like a lid, so it needs lighter trim or varied wall material before it's placeable.
